title: Team Huddle Reflection
description: The team gathers in a close huddle at the very end of practice for a brief, calm reflection on effort and teamwork before heading home.

content.objective: Close practice with a brief, calm moment that reinforces effort and team connection.
content.setup: The whole team gathers in a close circle or huddle.
instructions: Ask one or two players to share something positive they saw from a teammate today.
The coach shares one specific thing the team did well.
End with a shared team cheer, phrase, or quiet moment, whatever fits the group's culture.
Dismiss the team calmly to finish practice.
coachingPoints: Keep it brief — a minute or two is plenty.
Make sure the moment feels genuine, not forced.
Rotate who gets to share so it doesn't become repetitive.
commonMistakes: Letting the huddle drag on too long after a tiring practice.
Only ever praising the same one or two players.
Skipping the breathing and stretching once the group gets talkative.
content.safety: No specific physical safety concerns; keep the tone positive and inclusive.
